desc: Implement a function to calculate the number of subarrays missing a specific set of values, given their positions.
Calculate $S_1$ by iterating through the array and using the previous occurrence of each value.
Iterate through each value $v$ from 1 to $N-1$, calculate $C(v, v+1)$ using the inclusion-exclusion principle on missing subarrays.
Compute the final answer as $S_1 - S_2$ and print it.
